cause.label: no_identifiable_cause
cause.what_happened: BTCT gapped down 10.6% at the open on 2026-09-23 and slid another 5.2% intraday, to 1.195 at 15:04 ET, on 0.46x normal dollar volume. There was no issuer filing on 09-21, 09-22 or 09-23 and no dated news, and bitcoin was flat (-0.41%), so the fall reads as giving back the news-less 12.4% pop of 09-21. It came five days after a resale registration took effect covering 6.14M PIPE shares bought at $1.14, which is 52% of the 11.8M shares outstanding.

evidence.claim: The resale F-1 was declared effective on 2026-09-17 (accepted 2026-09-18 04:15 UTC). The 424B3 prospectus followed on 2026-09-18. It registers 18,421,050 shares: 5,175,437 issued, 964,913 behind pre-funded warrants and 12,280,700 behind common warrants. 11,800,567 shares are outstanding.
The PIPE sold 6,140,350 units at $1.14, each with two common warrants exercisable at $1.71. Aegis was the placement agent. No company lock-up is disclosed.
No BTCT filings on 2026-09-21, 09-22 or 09-23. The latest is the 424B3 of 09-18.
Bitcoin was down 0.41% day on day on the morning of 09-23, so this is not a crypto-tape move.
The stock rose 12.4% on 09-21 with no new filing, on an article recapping earlier MOUs, the Georgia facility and the bid-price compliance cure.

pipeline.next_dated_event: None found inside the window. The only item with a clock is the registered resale supply, which is continuous and can trade on 2026-09-24.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A 6-K before the 09-24 open announcing a contract or a financing would outweigh the supply read. So would a volume signature showing the 6.14M registered PIPE shares had already cleared, which today's roughly 1.6M shares cannot show.

positioning_check: Short interest was 4,474,550 shares at the 08/31/2026 settlement, up 71.8% from 2,604,191 on 08/14. Days to cover was 1.0 on a spiked 51.1M average daily volume. That is about 38% of the 11.8M shares outstanding. It is stale by more than three weeks and FINRA publishes about eight business days after settlement, so the position carried into this fall is not observable (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/BTCT/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). Insiders: zero Form 4 trades in 3 or 12 months (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/company/BTCT/insider-trades). No option chain, so no skew.

findings.finding: 6.14M PIPE shares, including 0.96M behind pre-funded warrants, are free to sell under a resale registration effective since 2026-09-17. That is 52% of the 11.8M outstanding and about 1.2 median days of volume. The holders paid $1.14, spot is 1.195, and they keep two $1.71 warrants per unit, so selling the stock leaves their warrant upside intact. That supply can keep reaching the tape on 2026-09-24.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The registration is already effective (EFFECT 09-17, 424B3 09-18) and no lock-up is disclosed, so any sale can print on 09-24 with no further filing. It is a live supply source during the window, not a dated future event.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the resale F-1/A was filed on 09-08, the 09-10 fall (-15.6%) was followed by +11.5%. The 09-15 fall (-19.0%) was followed by -8.9%. The only comparable fall since the registration took effect is today's. Own-history median over 27 comparable falls is -0.29%.
findings.why_not_priced: Today's fall came on 0.46x volume, about $1.9M or roughly 1.6M shares by 15:04 ET. That cannot have absorbed 6.14M registered shares whose cost basis is 5% below spot. If the supply were spent, the fall would have shown a volume spike well above the 20-day median, and it shows the opposite.
findings.independence: The PIPE terms ($1.14 units, $1.71 warrants, no disclosed lock-up) come from the separate 6-K of 2026-07-06: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1796514/000121390026075195/ea0296217-6k_btcdigi.htm. No independent evidence that the holders are actually selling.

outside_window.finding: Bid-price relapse. At 1.195 the stock is within 25% of $1 after the cure confirmed in the 09-02/09-04 6-Ks. A new deficiency needs 30 consecutive business days below $1, so nothing can land by 09-24.

Going-concern language repeats in the 09-18 424B3. Financing is likely to recur; the company has used ATMs before (2025 424B5) and has an $11.8M share count, but no open ATM is registered now, so no draw is possible tonight.
Mining at the Georgia 10MW facility is expected to start about two months after the August completion announcement.
12.28M common warrants at $1.71 are out of the money at 1.195. There is no exercise overhang or proceeds unless the stock rises about 43%.
